title: Chikmagalur Coffee & Cloud Peaks
summary: 3-day weekend escape across lush coffee plantations, rugged 4x4 jeep trails to roaring waterfalls, highest peak trekking at Mullayanagiri (1,930m), and scenic ridge cruising on 125cc scooties.

basecamp.name: Tresca A Luxury Hotel
basecamp.location: RG Road, Vijayapura (Opp. Renukacharya Kalyana Mantapa)
basecamp.proximity: 850m from KSRTC Main Bus Stand (~2 min auto)
basecamp.arrivalStrategy: 9:30 AM arrival: Drop bags at 24-hr cloakroom, freshen up in lobby washroom, and head out immediately for breakfast and sightseeing without carrying luggage.

outbound.title: Going Journey: Bengaluru ➔ Chikmagalur
outbound.notes: Highway food stop at Paakashala Yediyur on NH 75. 2-min auto from bus stand to Tresca Hotel.

returnTrip.title: Return Journey: Chikmagalur ➔ Bengaluru
returnTrip.notes: Settle scooty deposit by 08:30 PM, dinner on RG Road, board 10:30 PM sleeper. Coffee packages in cabin.

itinerary.title: Arrival, Bag Drop at Tresca, Private Cab to Jhari Falls & Mullayanagiri Sunset

events.title: Arrival at KSRTC Stand & Bag Drop at Tresca
events.desc: 2-min auto to hotel, cloakroom drop, change into hill clothes.

events.title: Breakfast at Vishnu Delicacy & Cab Pickup
events.desc: Authentic Mangalore buns, filter coffee, board private sightseeing cab.

events.title: Jhari (Buttermilk) Falls 4x4 Jeep Off-road
events.desc: Board 4x4 open jeep down bumpy dirt trails to the roaring estate waterfall.

events.title: Mullayanagiri Peak Ascent (1,930m)
events.desc: Ascend Karnataka's highest peak along windy ridge path.

events.title: Hirekolale Lake Sunset
events.desc: Tranquil artificial lake surrounded by Western Ghats slopes.

itinerary.title: 125cc Scooty Pickup, Baba Budangiri & Z-Point Ridge Walk
itinerary.highlight: Ghat Riding & Cloud Walking along Z-Point

events.title: 125cc Scooty Rental Pickup
events.desc: Inspect brakes/tyres, take helmet, deposit ID, fill fuel at Indian Oil.

events.title: Baba Budangiri Shrine & Caves
events.desc: Ride winding roads through dense green canopy to ancient shrine.

events.title: Kemmangundi & Z-Point Ridge Hike
events.desc: Spectacular 3km scenic ridge walk looking down over deep valleys.

events.title: Town Caffee Estate Tasting
events.desc: Artisan pour-overs and hot coffee sipping.

itinerary.title: Belur Hoysala Temple / Aldur Canopy, Coffee Shopping & Night Bus
itinerary.highlight: UNESCO 12th Century Architecture & Fresh Malnad Spices

events.title: Belur Chennakeshava Temple Visit
events.desc: Marvel at soapstone carvings and Hoysala architectural genius.

events.title: Coffee Board Museum & RG Road Shopping
events.desc: Panduranga Arabica/Robusta coffee powder, green cardamom, black pepper.

events.title: Scooty Return & Dinner
events.desc: Settle scooty deposit, leisurely South Indian dinner at Town Caffee.

events.title: Board KSRTC AC Sleeper Bus to BLR
events.desc: Board night bus back to Bengaluru (arrives ~05:00 AM Tue).
